item.title: Benchmarking an Open-Source AI Decision Model on a 2019 Laptop

description.p: I can’t afford the Jev API, so I ran the open-source Laya model on a 2019 GTX 1650 laptop instead: 847 ms per decision, a 4 GB VRAM memory problem, and a lesson about question design.

item.title: Beyond the Scorecard: Decoding Team Strategies in IPL 2025 Using Data Science

item.title: From Raw Data to Actionable Insights: My 3-Day Deep Dive into Data Science Salaries
